en: Welcome to Turffield Stadium! Milo's gym mission is through the doors behind me: herd the Wooloo into their pens.
Walk into a Wooloo and it trots along ahead of you. Clear the way, and Milo will be waiting on the pitch.
Congratulations on the Grass Badge! Hulbury's gym is next, down Route 5.
Milo's Grass types shrug off water and ground, but fire and flying moves give them a hard time!
You beat Milo! That's one badge down. Seven to go!
